dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a concave curvature, following a smooth inward spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is classified as rounded with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a steep posterior incline of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum base width to the vertical height from the dorsal ridge is approximately 1.3:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The cranial boundary exhibits a broad, smooth convex arc from the dorsal region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and blunt beak projection where the visible longitudinal length is approximately equal to its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A shallow obtuse angle is measurable at the pixel transition where the melon curvature meets the dorsal surface of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single circular depigmented anomaly is visible on the upper flank, positioned anterior to the vertical axis of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp tri-color pigmentation gradient is present, featuring a dark dorsal field, a light-grey lateral field, and a high-luminance white ventral field.
